verdict.rationale: Rippling's docs say time off syncs with payroll from a single system (docs-18) and that employees can request time off in the app (docs-28). Approvals are described only generically, as dynamic role-based rules enforced across apps (docs-35). Nothing in the evidence shows defining PTO policies or configuring accrual rules. Missing for 10: PTO policy configuration, accrual rules, PTO-specific approval workflows, independent corroboration that time off applies automatically to payroll.
